Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Relay maintenance notices now appear as a small self-dismissing toast instead of taking over your whole window. DJ List genre tags are now capped to two lines per card (with a "+N" chip for the rest) so every card keeps the same layout. Fixed Save Listing occasionally getting stuck on "Saving..." with no way to tell if it would ever finish. Fixed a scrollbar flash while the DJ Deck window un-minimizes or maximizes, and fixed the window/drawer borders disappearing behind other Dalamud windows.
